thesis_statement: Palantir is the operating-system layer of the AI adoption cycle: AIP-driven U.S. commercial revenue +149% with total revenue +93% at a 47% GAAP operating margin (Rule of 40 at 155%), $9.2B of net cash, and a U.S. commercial remaining-deal-value book (+124% YoY) that makes the growth partially pre-sold; the open question is only what multiple that franchise deserves.

base.summary: Revenue growth decelerates from 93% toward the guided ~82% FY pace while GAAP margins hold near current levels; the stock digests its multiple rather than collapsing.
drivers: GAAP operating margin 47% with GAAP profitability guided every quarter of 2026

bull.summary: The sovereign-AI and enterprise-AI wave keeps widening Palantir's deal book (73 deals of $10M+ this quarter) and margins expand past 50% GAAP as the platform scales.

bear.summary: AI-platform spending normalizes, growth decelerates toward 30-40%, and a ~162x trailing multiple de-rates severely even with execution intact.
drivers: AI-narrative concentration in both government and commercial demand
any large-deal slippage visible in the RDV book

key_risks: Valuation is the dominant risk: ~162x trailing and ~82x forward earnings price in years of flawless execution; a growth miss is a multiple event, not an earnings event.
The close (189.63) is 13.1% above the SQL band high - the band predates the post-Q2 rerating and offers no timing support; 10-03 renewal should widen it.
Customer concentration in the AI buildout: both commercial AIP adoption and government demand ride the same AI-capex narrative; a broad AI-spending pause hits both.
Stock-based-compensation-heavy compensation model means adjusted margins (62%) flatter GAAP economics (47%); judge GAAP.

invalidation_reasons.price: Close below the live guarded-SQL reference_invalidation_level (150.66 at the 2026-09-26 renewal). SQL governs after any later renewal; this text does not.
fundamental: U.S. commercial revenue growth falls below 40% year over year for two consecutive quarters.
GAAP operating margin falls below 30% for two consecutive quarters.
U.S. commercial remaining deal value declines quarter over quarter for two consecutive quarters.

catalysts.event: FY26 guidance raises (company has raised each quarter of 2026)
